contributions.original_prompts:
New raw `raw/stripe-payments-scalapay-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw `raw/stripe-scalapay-accept-payment-2025.md`. Current summaries `wiki/sources/source-stripe-scalapay-accept-payment.md`.

- Q1. For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/scalapay/accept-a-payment`, what documented behavior, prerequisites, actors and state transitions does the complete new capture establish? How do these compare with the matched prior capture and each mapped summary?

- Q2. Which changes are substantive, presentational or navigation-only? Identify the exact dated qualifications, conflicts and reciprocal routes that the proposed disposition should preserve.

reviewed_answers.Q1: The November 7, 2026 capture at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/scalapay/accept-a-payment identifies Scalapay acceptance and gives four variant links (new raw lines 5-17), without supplying prerequisites, payment steps or state transitions. The May 6 guide documents a single-use three- or four-installment flow in which the customer authorizes with Scalapay and returns for an immediate stated success/failure outcome (old raw lines 12-35 and 1160-1164). The May Checkout and Elements/Checkout Sessions paths list eight countries, EUR same-currency lines and payment mode without setup/subscription. For those paths the merchant creates a Checkout Session, using a hosted success URL or a Session return URL for Elements with Checkout Sessions. The May Elements/Payment Intents and Direct API paths create an Intent server-side and confirm with a return URL. The optional Direct API manual redirect follows requires_action and next_action.redirect_to_url, and the application verifies payment status on return (old raw lines 125-197, 799-933 and 1268-1362). Manual authorization transitions to requires_capture, followed by capture or cancellation (old raw lines 1094-1140). source-stripe-scalapay-accept-payment.md lists the four paths and seven-day window, but overgeneralizes the currency and return URL and omits the second Checkout Sessions scope.
reviewed_answers.Q2: The November change at https://docs.stripe.com/payments/scalapay/accept-a-payment is presentation and navigation only. New raw lines 9-17 link four implementation bodies and establish no substantive behavior change or deprecation. Preserve the May 6, 2026 Checkout and Elements/Checkout Sessions eight-country, EUR-only, same-currency and payment-mode compatibility (old raw lines 18-35 and 95-112). Correct the global EUR-only statement in source-stripe-scalapay-accept-payment.md because the Direct API May map lists non-EUR cases (old raw lines 1376-1391) while the separate same-date method overview lists EUR for all 28 business locations (raw/stripe-scalapay-2025.md lines 52-93 and 160-170). The malformed Checkout comment at old raw line 58 is insufficient to override its table. Preserve hosted Checkout success_url versus Session/Intent return_url, and the seven-day Intent authorization, capture and cancellation flow (old raw lines 50-70, 125-197, 927-933 and 1094-1140). At the concept route, retain the May method Connect No versus both BNPL matrices' Supported flags and the November BNPL API table omission. The separate November Mobile Payment Element matrix change supplies no missing variant body. Preserve root index line 7, Stripe index lines 345 and 747, and the BNPL concept's source link (line 267), with a reciprocal source link and separate November navigation reference.
